Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. (TSX: AVL) (OTCQB: AVLNF) ("Avalon" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has closed a non-brokered private placement (the "Offering") of 615,400 flow-through common shares of the Company (the "FT Shares") at a price of C$6.50 per FT Share, representing a premium of approximately 24.3% to the Company's closing share price of C$5.23 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on November 17, 2026, for aggregate gross proceeds of C$4,000,100.

The gross proceeds from the Offering will be used to incur eligible Canadian exploration expenses that qualify as "flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures" under the Income Tax Act (Canada), principally in connection with the advancement of Avalon's Nechalacho Rare Earths and Zirconium Project in the Northwest Territories, subject to applicable tax requirements. Planned activities include exploration drilling and related technical work to support ongoing resource evaluation and the next phase of project development.

"This financing provides targeted capital to advance our work at Nechalacho while leveraging the flow-through structure to support critical minerals exploration in Canada," said Scott Monteith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Avalon. "Our ongoing technical program is intended to strengthen the project's underlying data set and support the work required to progress Nechalacho toward its next development milestones."

Offering details

Each FT Share was issued as a "flow-through share" within the meaning of subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada). The FT Shares were issued pursuant to available prospectus exemptions under applicable Canadian securities laws and are subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the closing date of the Offering.

Red Cloud Securities Inc. ("Red Cloud") acted as finder in connection with the Offering. In consideration for its services, Red Cloud is entitled to a cash finder's fee equal to 7.0% of the gross proceeds attributable to subscribers introduced by Red Cloud and finder warrants equal to 7.0% of the number of FT Shares placed with those subscribers. Each finder warrant is exercisable to acquire one common share of Avalon at C$6.50 per share for a period of 24 months following closing of the Offering.

This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities in the United States. The securities described in this news release have not been, and will not be, registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "U.S. Securities Act"), or any applicable state securities laws and may not be offered or sold in the United States or to US persons (as defined in Regulation S under the U.S. Securities Act) absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration.

About Avalon Advanced Materials Inc.

Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. is a Canadian critical minerals company focused on advancing lithium and rare earth elements-two of the fastest-growing segments of the global energy transition. The Company is developing strategic assets to participate in high-growth markets and support the build-out of secure North American supply chains. Avalon is advancing the Nechalacho Rare Earth Elements and Zirconium Project in the Northwest Territories, which contains all light and heavy rare earth elements, as well as zirconium, tantalum, and niobium-critical minerals used in advanced technologies across the communications, defense, advanced technologies, and energy sectors. The Company is also focused on vertically integrating the Ontario lithium supply chain through the development of Lake Superior Lithium Inc., Ontario's first midstream lithium hydroxide processing facility, located in Thunder Bay. This facility is expected to serve as a cornerstone of North America's integrated battery materials supply chain, transforming northern Ontario lithium into essential inputs for transportation, grid storage, and advanced manufacturing.

New York, New York--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Sparta Commercial Services, Inc. (OTCQB: SRCO) ("Sparta" or the "Company"), a provider of municipal and other financing solutions, today announced the completion of an additional municipal financing transaction with Hyde County, North Carolina through Sparta's Municipal Finance Program.

This marks the third municipal financing transaction Sparta has completed with Hyde County since 2018 and supported the Hyde County Emergency Services Department's acquisition of two new ambulances.

"Over the years, Sparta has proven to be a reliable financing partner for Hyde County," said Joey Williams, Emergency Management Director for Hyde County. "Their team understands the operational and budgetary realities municipalities face, and they consistently provide a financing process that is efficient, flexible, and easy to navigate. These new ambulances are critical to helping us continue delivering emergency services to our community."

Sparta's Municipal Finance Program helps municipalities and public agencies secure the equipment and infrastructure they need through customized financing solutions designed to preserve annual operating budgets and reduce large upfront capital expenditures. The program finances a broad spectrum of essential-use assets, including ambulances, fire and rescue equipment, law enforcement vehicles, public transportation assets, and a variety of other mission-critical municipal equipment.

"We value long-term relationships with municipalities and are proud when clients continue to return to Sparta for additional financing needs," said Anthony Havens, Chief Executive Officer of Sparta Commercial Services. "Repeat business from Hyde County reflects the trust we work hard to build with municipal clients and equipment providers alike. Our goal is to help municipalities access the essential equipment they need today while preserving financial flexibility for the future."

Visit www.spartamunicipal.com for more information about Sparta's Municipal Finance Program.

Fortune 500 leader succeeds Joi Tillman, now Chief Product Experience Officer

WELLESLEY, Mass., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sunlife U.S., a leading provider of employee and government benefits, has appointed Stephanie Shields as president of its Group Benefits business, which includes life, disability, absence management, paid leave, supplemental health, and dental and vision insurance, as well as an array of virtual health capabilities and condition-specific services. Sunlife Group Benefits solutions can be tailored for employers of all sizes and are designed to increase access to care and improve health outcomes. Effective Nov. 9, Shields took over the reins from Joi Tillman, who recently assumed the role of Chief Product Experience Officer.

"At Sunlife U.S., we're focused on connecting health and benefits, closing coverage gaps and delivering more seamless experiences for clients and members," said David Healy, president, Sunlife U.S. "Stephanie has the right mix of experience in scaling businesses, leading teams and harnessing innovation to better serve clients. With Joi dedicated to creating simpler, connected experiences across our products and Stephanie driving our employee benefits engine, we have a strong team in place. I look forward to what's to come and welcome Stephanie to the team."

Shields is an accomplished benefits industry executive with a proven track record of leveraging technology to turn strategy into measurable results and deliver profitable growth.

"I am thrilled to join Sunlife to lead the Group Benefits business during this time of accelerated change in the industry, including new technologies, advancements in AI and automation," said Shields. "With scalable, disciplined investments and process optimization, we can help employers provide robust, affordable benefits packages that improve employee health outcomes. I look forward to engaging with the employee benefits team to continue the momentum built under Joi Tillman's leadership."

Prior to joining Sunlife, Shields served as head of Employee Benefits at Equitable Holdings as well as a member of the company's Operating Committee. She scaled an early-stage business into a profitable employee benefits platform, while strengthening pricing and actuarial capabilities, improving operating efficiency, and building a high-performing culture. Before Equitable, Shields held senior leadership roles at Aflac across broker distribution, strategy, product and marketing. She also led voluntary benefits, strategy and product development at Cigna and began her career in marketing and client delivery with Willis Towers Watson.

Shields earned an MBA in marketing and finance from Drexel University, LeBow College of Business and a bachelor's degree in biobehavioral health from The Pennsylvania State University. She currently serves as a strategic advisor to an Insurtech AI startup and is on the advisory board for Furman University's Center for Innovative Leadership. She was recognized as a 2023 Top 10 Employee Benefits Leader by HR Tech Outlook and is a member of the Group Insurance Executive Committee at the American Council of Life Insurers (ACLI).

About Sunlife
Sunlife is a leading international financial services organization providing asset management, wealth, insurance and health solutions to individual and institutional Clients. Sunlife has operations in a number of markets worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., the United Kingdom, Ireland, Hong Kong, the Philippines, Japan, Indonesia, India, China, Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia and Bermuda. As of September 30, 2026, Sunlife had total assets under management of $1.68 trillion. For more information, please visit www.sunlife.com. 

Sun Life Financial Inc. trades on the Toronto (TSX), New York (NYSE) and Philippine (PSE) stock exchanges under the ticker symbol SLF.

Through employers, industry partners and government programs, Sunlife U.S. offers a portfolio of benefits and services, including dental, vision, disability, absence management, life, supplemental health, medical stop-loss insurance, and healthcare navigation. Sunlife employs nearly 8,300 people in the U.S., including associates in our partner dental practices and affiliated companies in asset management. TORONTO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Blue Moon Metals Inc. ("Blue Moon" or the "Company") (TSXV: MOON) (NASDAQ: BMM) is pleased to announce a major permitting milestone at its 100%-owned Blue Moon zinc-gold-silver-copper mine (the "Blue Moon Mine" or the "Project") in Mariposa County, California. The U.S. Bureau of Land Management ("BLM") has approved the Project's Plan of Operations (the "Plan of Operations"). The Company submitted the Plan of Operations to the BLM Mother Lode Field Office on August 6, 2026. It is the principal permit required to construct and operate the Blue Moon Mine.

Underground Development Update

Construction of the exploration decline began on October 5, 2025. Since then, the Company has advanced the decline approximately 4,000 feet. Underground infill drilling is now underway from the decline. The program is designed to increase confidence in the resource and support detailed mine planning.

Skott Mealer, President and Chief Operating Officer of Blue Moon, stated: "Approval of the Plan of Operations is a major milestone for the Blue Moon Mine and for our strategy of bringing past-producing critical mineral mines in the western United States back into production. I want to thank the BLM Mother Lode Field Office for its thorough and constructive review, and Mariposa County and our local stakeholders for their continued engagement. With the decline about 4,000 feet in and infill drilling under way, we are moving steadily toward restart of the Blue Moon Mine."

The Company continues to advance the remaining ancillary permits and approvals customary for a project of this nature.

Upcoming Milestones

The Company continues to complete its core relogging, assaying and drilling program at the Blue Moon Mine, and expects to provide results of the program in the coming weeks. Additionally, Blue Moon is reviewing a number of opportunities for potential toll processing of the Project's ores, which could accelerate the timeline to commence production.

Qualified Persons

The technical and scientific information of this news release has been reviewed and approved by Mr. Reza Ehsani, P.Eng., a Blue Moon Officer, and a non-Independent Qualified Person, as defined by NI 43-101.

About Blue Moon

Blue Moon is advancing 6 brownfield polymetallic projects, including the Nussir copper-gold-silver project in Norway, the NSG copper-zinc-gold-silver project in Norway, the Blue Moon zinc-gold-silver-copper project in the United States, the Springer tungsten-molybdenum project in the United States, the Apex germanium-gallium-copper project in the United States and the Turner gold-copper-zinc-silver project in the United States. All 6 projects are well located with existing local infrastructure including roads, power and historical infrastructure. Zinc, copper and tungsten are currently on the USGS and EU list of metals critical to the global economy and national security and germanium and gallium are also on the USGS list of critical metals. Major shareholders include Teck Resources Limited, funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, Hartree Partners LP, Wheaton Precious Metals, Altius Minerals Corporation, Baker Steel Resources Trust, LNS and Monial. Strategic partnership will target high-powered manufacturing assets with up to $480 Million in investment capacity

AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Blue Yonder Property Group ("BYPG"), a thematic real estate investment firm focused on high-power manufacturing assets, today announced a strategic partnership with GCM Grosvenor (Nasdaq: GCMG), a leading middle market real estate platform builder and GP stakes investor. GCM Grosvenor has invested an initial $62.5 million to launch the platform, which is structured to scale up to $300 million of equity over time. With the initial investment, BYPG and GCM Grosvenor intend to build a portfolio of high-powered manufacturing facilities across high-growth U.S. markets representing approximately $480 million in aggregate property value. As part of the partnership, GCM Grosvenor will join BYPG's Board of Directors.

Founded in 2023 by Bobby Dillard and Tyler Buckler, BYPG is vertically integrated across acquisitions, asset management, development, and operations. Its principals previously led Cielo Property Group, where they executed more than $800 million in retail and office investments between 2010 and 2022. Their approach has been to identify sector shifts early, from post-crisis suburban retail to creative and technology office, and to execute directly as developers and operators. Since forming BYPG, the team has developed 250,000 square feet of bulk logistics space and repositioned 135,000 square feet of infill shallow-bay industrial.

The platform will target manufacturing facilities with in-place power infrastructure, serving manufacturers in aerospace and defense, electrification, energy, advanced materials and the digital infrastructure supply chain, with initial focus on Dallas–Fort Worth, Houston, Austin–San Antonio, Phoenix and the Carolinas' I-85 corridor. The strategy seeks to capitalize on the rapidly growing demand for manufacturing facilities with sufficient power, amid increasing constraints on the U.S. power grid.

Manufacturing now accounts for 20 percent of new industrial leasing in the Southeast and Central U.S., up from 13 percent before the pandemic, yet larger users face one- to two-year delays to secure sufficient power, according to PwC and the Urban Land Institute's Emerging Trends in Real Estate 2026. For those users, a building with power already in place is the fastest path to production. By acquiring and repositioning high-powered facilities, BYPG aims to capitalize on this supply-demand imbalance, turning existing grid capacity into ready-to-operate manufacturing space, and helping close the gap between where demand is growing and where power is available.

The first acquisition under the strategy, 2000 Clovis Barker Road in San Marcos, Texas, is a 75,276-square-foot, crane-served manufacturing facility on approximately 30 acres along the I-35 corridor between Austin and San Antonio. The property benefits from 2.5 megawatts of secured power capacity, and BYPG has executed a long-term lease with an established national industrial pipe fabrication company that will fully occupy the facility at closing.

Ermias Nessibu, Executive Director, Real Estate at GCM Grosvenor, said, "Our real estate strategy is built on partnering with specialized operators and helping them scale into institutional investment management platforms. Bobby, Tyler and the BYPG team have a proven track record of identifying emerging opportunities and executing in operationally complex sectors. Growing demand for high-power manufacturing facilities is colliding with limited suitable inventory, high development barriers and constrained access to power. We believe these structural supply-demand dynamics create a compelling investment opportunity, and we look forward to partnering with BYPG to build a leading institutional platform focused on this underserved segment of the industrial market "

Bobby Dillard, CEO and Co-Chief Investment Officer of BYPG, added, "We're grateful to GCM Grosvenor for their partnership and for the conviction they've shown in our team and this strategy. Power capacity has become one of the hardest things to replicate in industrial real estate, and manufacturers increasingly decide where to grow based on where it's available. GCM's partnership allows us to assemble a portfolio of these hard-to-replace assets at scale and deliver that capacity to the companies driving America's reindustrialization."

About Blue Yonder Property Group

Blue Yonder Property Group (BYPG) is an Austin-based real estate investment manager that builds thematic strategies around emerging market trends and dislocations. Its founders have executed more than $800 million of value-add and development investments together since 2010. BYPG's current focus is high-power manufacturing, a strategy at the intersection of infrastructure and industrial real estate that acquires and repositions existing manufacturing facilities with significant in-place power capacity and mission-critical infrastructure across high-growth U.S. markets. The firm combines operator-led execution, long-standing industry relationships and a dedicated off-market acquisitions platform. For more information, visit bypg.com.

About GCM Grosvenor

GCM Grosvenor (Nasdaq: GCMG) is a global alternative asset management solutions provider with approximately $97 billion in assets under management across private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return strategies. Specializing in alternatives for more than 50 years, the firm serves a global institutional and individual client base through a team of approximately 550 professionals. GCM Grosvenor is headquartered in Chicago, with offices in New York, Toronto, London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Seoul, and Sydney. For more information, visit gcmgrosvenor.com.

Aether Compute will utilize Cho Thavee Public Company Limited's existing approximately 14-acre factory site in Khon Kaen, with a reported 0.85 MW of existing power capacity, as the proposed foundation for an AI data center joint venture

  • The partnership is intended to combine CHO's industrial real estate, reported existing power and local operating experience with Aether Compute's technical and delivery capabilities.

  • Aether to hold a 47.5% interest in the proposed joint venture, alongside opportunities to support the project by providing infrastructure development, deployment and managed services.

  • Advance Capital Partners to support initial project setup, regulatory coordination and capital-raising activities.

New York, New York--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Aether Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ATHR) ("Aether" or the "Company"), a technology holding company focused on expanding its AI infrastructure and enterprise technology services business through its Aether Compute subsidiary, today announced that it has entered into a binding tripartite framework agreement with Cho Thavee Public Company Limited (SET: CHO) ("CHO") and Advance Capital Partners Limited ("ACP"), a Singapore-based capital partner, establishing the principal terms for a proposed joint venture to develop and operate an AI data center project in Khon Kaen, Thailand.

Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Khon Kaen, CHO is a Thai manufacturer of trailers, specialty vehicles and transit buses. Aether Compute identified CHO's existing factory as a strong starting point for AI infrastructure development in Thailand and proposed the joint venture to CHO. The partnership combines CHO's industrial real estate, existing power and local operating experience with Aether Compute's technical and delivery capabilities, with potential room for expansion within the site.

The proposed initial phase would target the approximately 14-acre factory site, which has reported existing power capacity of 0.85 MW, subject to site assessment and required approvals. This phased approach could allow initial development to proceed around available resources, with any additional capacity pursued only as customer demand, power availability, financing and project economics support.

Under the framework agreement, CHO would contribute the proposed site to the joint venture through below-market long-term site leases and purchase options, along with its existing power and local operating experience, with site selection and development phasing subject to assessment and required project approvals.

Aether Compute would contribute enterprise technology expertise and support the project through AetherMDC infrastructure planning and deployment services and its AetherPod modular data center offering. Its anticipated role would extend from configuring and integrating systems to providing platform licensing and ongoing managed services.

Upon formation of the joint venture, Aether and CHO would each hold 47.5% of the joint venture and ACP would hold the remaining 5% in connection with its role in facilitating initial setup, regulatory coordination and capital-raising activities during the implementation phase. The joint venture is expected to seek third-party financing for project expenditures, and Aether would have no obligation to fund or guarantee those expenditures absent a separate written commitment. There can be no assurance that such financing will be available on acceptable terms or at all.

"This project represents an opportunity for Aether Compute to extend its enterprise technology services into a broader infrastructure development role, along with a potential path to recurring platform and service revenue," said Nicolas Lin, Chief Executive Officer of Aether Holdings. "The proposed structure lets us take part in AI infrastructure development with limited use of our balance sheet. We see an opportunity to pair our technical and delivery capabilities with local industrial assets to address enterprise and AI computing requirements, and we believe CHO can provide a practical starting point in Thailand."

"The factory in Khon Kaen offers an opportunity to put our existing industrial space and available power to work as a foundation for AI computing infrastructure," said Suradech Taweesaengsakulthai, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of CHO Thavee. "Working with Aether Compute, we aim to begin with an initial deployment and make greater use of the site's available space as demand grows. This partnership is intended to combine our facilities and local experience with Aether's technical capabilities to develop and manage that infrastructure."

About Aether Compute

Aether Compute is the AI infrastructure business of Aether Holdings, focused on modular data center solutions, infrastructure design and deployment, managed IT services and strategic technology partnerships supporting AI, enterprise and other compute-intensive workloads.

Actively managed IncomeQ Nasdaq-100® Premium Income ETF seeks to generate income by selling put options on individual stocks and index-related instruments while pursuing outperformance over a full market cycle.

NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Quantify Funds today announced the launch of the IncomeQ Nasdaq-100® Premium Income ETF (IQQI), an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to pursue capital appreciation and current income through a differentiated approach to options investing.

The fund seeks exposure to the growth potential of the Nasdaq-100® while pursuing weekly cash distributions without relying on covered calls that limit gains above a predetermined strike price. It seeks to outperform the Nasdaq-100® over a full market cycle, although neither outperformance nor distributions are guaranteed.

IQQI takes a different approach to generating options income. Rather than primarily selling call options against its market exposure, the fund sells put options and put spreads on selected individual stocks and Nasdaq-100® -related instruments. Its investment managers actively evaluate where options premiums appear attractive relative to the risks assumed.

“Investors shouldn't have to look at income and growth as completely separate objectives,” said David Dziekanski, Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Chief Investment Officer of Quantify Funds. “The question we asked was whether there is another way to pursue both without automatically giving up upside in strong markets. IQQI reflects our belief that investment innovation starts by challenging familiar trade-offs and understanding the risks behind a different approach.”

Finding Opportunity in the Demand for Protection

A central element of IQQI's investment thesis is that investors do not always purchase options for the same reasons.

Company founders, executives and other concentrated shareholders may seek protection against declines in individual stocks because of the potential financial consequences of a large loss. That demand can influence options pricing, potentially creating opportunities for investors willing to assume the corresponding downside risk.

IQQI seeks to evaluate these opportunities through active options management, selling puts or put spreads on individual stocks where the investment team believes the premiums provide attractive compensation for the risk. The fund can also use options on the Nasdaq-100® or related ETFs when those opportunities appear more attractive.

“Options pricing reflects more than a forecast of where a stock is headed. It also reflects why investors want protection,” said Zed Francis, Co-Founder and Chief Investment Officer of Convexitas. “Concentrated shareholders and institutions may have reasons to hedge that go beyond short-term market expectations. Our focus is on evaluating what investors are willing to pay for that protection and whether the compensation justifies the risk of providing it.”

An Alternative Balance of Growth, Income and Risk

IQQI seeks to maintain uncapped upside exposure to the Nasdaq-100® while generating options premiums that may support weekly distributions. Its actively managed approach allows the investment team to adjust positions based on changing market conditions, volatility and options pricing.

That strategy involves meaningful trade-offs. Selling put options creates additional downside exposure, and the fund can experience losses greater than those of the Nasdaq-100 during sharp market declines. The fund's performance can also differ from the index because of its holdings, derivatives, fees and trading costs.

Weekly distributions are not guaranteed, may fluctuate and may include return of capital rather than investment profits.

IQQI is part of Quantify Funds' broader commitment to developing investment strategies through disciplined research, innovation and transparency about investment risk.

November 19, 2026 – TheNewswire - Timmins, Ontario – Melkior Resources Inc. ("Melkior" or the "Company") (TSXV: MKR) (OTCQB: MKRIF) is pleased to announce that drilling has commenced on its 12-hole, approximately 4,400-metre diamond drill program at the Beschefer East Project (the "Project") in the Northern Abitibi Greenstone Belt, located approximately 90 km west of Matagami and 100 km north of La Sarre, Québec.

Highlights

  • The program will be completed in two phases and is designed to test four target areas characterized by historical gold and polymetallic mineralization associated with coincident induced polarization ("IP") chargeability anomalies, electromagnetic ("EM") conductors and magnetic features. Planned hole lengths range from approximately 250 to 700 metres. 

  • Phase 1 (fall 2026): four holes totalling approximately 1,400 metres testing the interpreted northern extension of the B14 gold trend along a north-south magnetic and IP chargeability corridor. 

  • Historical intercepts in the Phase 1 target area include 2.1 g/t Au over 5.4 metres, including 7.9 g/t Au over 0.9 metres, in hole 1172-13-40 and 2.03 g/t Au over 6.1 metres in hole 1172-99-30. 

  • Phase 2 (winter 2027): eight holes totalling approximately 3,065 metres testing the eastern extensions of the B14 gold trend and the B26 gold-base metal volcanogenic massive sulphide ("VMS") trend, as well as structurally controlled gold targets along the Enjalran-Brouillan Group contact. 

  • Forage DCB Inc., a Québec-based drilling contractor, has mobilized to the property and Phase 1 drilling is now underway. Phase 1 is expected to take approximately three to four weeks, with assay results anticipated in the first quarter of 2027. 

Management Commentary

Bernard Deluce, CEO and Director, commented:

"The Beschefer East Project hosts several underexplored geophysical and geological targets supported by historical drilling and extensive geophysical coverage. This program has been designed to test priority gold and polymetallic targets identified by previous operators. We expect it to provide important information on the continuity and extent of the mineralized systems across the property and to help advance several prospective target areas."

2026 Fall Drill Program (Phase 1)

Phase 1 comprises four drill holes, BEE-20, BEE-39, BEE-40 and BEE-41, located south of the main access road. The holes are designed to evaluate the interpreted northern extension of the B14 gold mineralized trend along a north-south magnetic and IP chargeability corridor.

2027 Winter Drill Program (Phase 2)

Phase 2 is expected to comprise eight drill holes totalling approximately 3,065 metres and will target multiple mineralized trends identified through historical drilling and geophysical surveys.

Holes BEE-18, BEE-19, BEE-26 and BEE-27 are designed to test the interpreted eastern extension of the B14 gold trend, while hole BEE-42 will evaluate the extension of the B26 gold-base metal VMS trend. These targets are supported by historical drill results and coincident IP and magnetic anomalies.

Hole BEE-35 is planned to verify and follow up on historical Cu-Zn-Ag mineralization intersected by Noramco in hole H-1432-091, which returned 0.11% Cu, 0.24% Zn and 0.90 g/t Ag over 24.4 metres, including 0.61% Cu, 0.30% Zn and 6.6 g/t Ag over 6.0 metres.

Holes BEE-13 and BEE-14 will test gold targets associated with graphitic argillites along the Enjalran-Brouillan Group contact zone. These targets coincide with elevated IP chargeability responses and historical drilling that returned 3.45 g/t Au over 1.5 metres in hole 1172-95-02, and 3.37 g/t Au over 1.3 metres and 2.06 g/t Au over 2.5 metres in hole 1172-98-24.

About the Beschefer East Project

On June 14, 2023, the Company entered into an option agreement on the Project to earn a 100% interest over three years from SOQUEM Inc. ("SOQUEM") (see news release dated June 14, 2023). In March 2026, the option agreement was amended to extend the deadline for completing the cumulative exploration expenditure requirement of $1,500,000 by one year, from July 3, 2026, to July 3, 2027. All other terms of the option agreement remain unchanged.

The Project is located within the prospective yet underexplored Selbaie mining camp and comprises 55 mining claims covering 2,906 hectares.

Between 1992 and 2012, SOQUEM completed systematic exploration on the property, including more than 300 line-kilometres of geophysical surveys and 11,200 metres of diamond drilling in 42 holes.

In early 2025, Melkior completed a six-hole, 1,050-metre drill program testing a previously undrilled area in the east-central part of the property, where a 1,780-sample bio-geochemical (spruce bark MMI) survey had outlined five gold-polymetallic anomalies coincident with IP-EM conductors. Hole MKR-BE-2024-001 intersected 5.1 g/t Au, 0.95% Cu and 0.67% Zn over 0.9 metres and 7.5 g/t Au over 1.3 metres, confirming an 800-metre copper-gold mineralized horizon (see news release dated July 17, 2025).

Notable historical gold intersections from the northern powerline area include hole 1172-99-30, which intersected multiple mineralized zones grading between 2 and 5 g/t Au over intervals of 0.5 to 6.0 metres within a broader 70-metre mineralized corridor. Hole 1172-13-40 returned 2.1 g/t Au over 5.4 metres, including 7.9 g/t Au over 0.9 metres.

Gold mineralization is associated with networks of centimetre-scale quartz-carbonate veins hosted in felsic to intermediate volcanic rocks affected by varying degrees of pervasive alteration and minor pyrite. In the southern portion of the property, gold and base metal mineralization occurs within deformed, carbonate-altered andesites. Historical drilling also identified anomalous copper mineralization, including 0.26% Cu over 4.8 metres in hole 1172-98-24 and 0.24% Cu over 4.0 metres in hole 1172-99-30.

Sampling and Analytical Procedures

Drill core will be NQ in size. Core will be logged and sampled by Company geologists, with sampled intervals sawn in half; one half will be sent for analysis and the other retained for future reference. Samples will be delivered under chain-of-custody protocols to an independent, accredited commercial laboratory and analyzed for gold by fire assay with atomic absorption finish. Samples returning greater than 10 g/t Au will be re-analyzed by fire assay with gravimetric finish, and intervals containing visible gold will be analyzed by metallic screen fire assay.

Quality Assurance and Quality Control

The Company will implement a quality assurance and quality control ("QA/QC") program that includes the systematic insertion of certified reference materials, blank samples and duplicate samples into the sample stream. QA/QC results will be monitored by the Company's technical staff to evaluate analytical accuracy, contamination and precision.

Melkior Resources Inc. is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on the discovery and advancement of gold projects in the prolific mining jurisdictions of Ontario and Québec. The Company is committed to creating shareholder value through disciplined, technically driven exploration and the systematic evaluation of high-potential mineral assets.

Melkior's core portfolio is anchored by the Carscallen Gold Project, located in the heart of the Timmins Gold Camp, one of Canada's most productive gold districts.   • Two positive Phase 3 studies showed CAPLYTA significantly reduced manic symptoms versus placebo as early as Day 3, with improvement sustained through Week 3
  • As the first and only FDA-approved treatment for both bipolar I and II depression in adults as a monotherapy and adjunctive therapy, filing seeks to expand CAPLYTA for the treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder
  • Approval would mark the fifth approved use of CAPLYTA in adults, building on its robust efficacy and established safety and tolerability profile across major depressive disorder, bipolar depression and schizophrenia

NEW BRUNSWICK, N.J., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) today announced the submission of a supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) seeking the approval of CAPLYTA (lumateperone) for the treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder in adults. The submission is supported by two pivotal Phase 3 studies in which CAPLYTA significantly reduced manic symptoms versus placebo as early as Day 3, with improvement sustained through Week 3. If approved, bipolar mania would become the fifth approved use for CAPLYTA in adults.

An estimated 11 million U.S. adults experience bipolar disorder at some point in their lives.1 For people living with bipolar I disorder, manic episodes can escalate rapidly, disrupting daily life and putting their safety, relationships, career, and financial wellbeing at risk—and often are severe enough to require hospitalization.2,3

"For people experiencing acute mania, rapid symptom improvement and tolerability are both critical treatment considerations," said John C. Reed, M.D., Ph.D., Executive Vice President, Innovative Medicine, R&D, Johnson & Johnson. "Our Phase 3 results demonstrate the potential for CAPLYTA to address these needs, and this submission advances our ambition to provide a foundational treatment that can support patients across the evolving course of serious psychiatric disorders."

Pivotal Phase 3 Study Results 
The sNDA submission is based on positive results from Study 451 and Study 452, two pivotal Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled studies of once-daily CAPLYTA 42 mg versus placebo in adults with manic episodes, with or without mixed features, associated with bipolar I disorder. In both studies, CAPLYTA met the primary and key secondary endpoints, demonstrating significant and rapid improvement in bipolar mania symptoms and overall illness severity versus placebo. Improvement in manic symptoms was observed as early as Day 3, following two days of treatment. CAPLYTA was well tolerated, with low rates of discontinuation and a safety profile consistent with prior studies.4,5 

CAPLYTA is approved in adults living with depressive episodes associated with bipolar I or II disorder as monotherapy or adjunctive therapy, major depressive disorder as adjunctive therapy with antidepressants and schizophrenia. It is not approved for the treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder.

ABOUT BIPOLAR MANIA
An estimated 11 million U.S. adults experience bipolar disorder at some point in their lives.1 Mania is a defining feature of bipolar I disorder—a period of abnormally elevated or irritable mood and/or increased energy or activity that most people experience alongside depressive episodes over the course of the illness.6 Symptoms of mania can include grandiosity, decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, distractibility, and risk-taking behavior.6 Manic episodes can escalate quickly, often requiring hospitalization for safety and treatment.7 These noticeable behavioral changes often differ markedly from an individual's baseline and can have serious consequences for a person's safety, relationships, career, and finances, contributing to its standing as one of the leading causes of disability worldwide.2 Rapid and sustained control of manic symptoms remains an important treatment goal in the management of bipolar I disorder.

ABOUT STUDY 451 and STUDY 452
Studies 451 and 452 are two positive randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 studies of lumateperone versus placebo in adults with manic episodes, with or without mixed features, associated with bipolar I disorder. In each study, patients were randomized to receive once-daily lumateperone 42 mg or placebo for three weeks. The primary endpoint of each study was change from baseline in Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS) total score at Week 3, and the key secondary endpoint was change from baseline in Clinical Global Impression–Severity (CGI-S) score at Week 3.

ABOUT CAPLYTA (lumateperone)
CAPLYTA is an oral, once daily atypical antipsychotic approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in adults for the treatment of depressive episodes associated with bipolar I or II disorder (bipolar depression), as monotherapy or as adjunctive therapy with lithium or valproate; for the treatment of schizophrenia; and as adjunctive therapy with antidepressants for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD).

CAPLYTA is not approved for the treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder.

While the mechanism of action of CAPLYTA is unknown, the efficacy of CAPLYTA could be mediated through a combination of antagonist activity at central serotonin 5-HT2A receptors and partial agonist activity at central dopamine D2 receptors.

CAPLYTA IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

What is CAPLYTA (lumateperone)?

CAPLYTA (lumateperone) is a prescription medicine used in adults along with an antidepressant to treat major depressive disorder (MDD); to treat depressive episodes associated with bipolar I or bipolar II disorder (bipolar depression) alone or with lithium or valproate; or to treat schizophrenia. It is not known if CAPLYTA is safe and effective in children.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

What is the most important information I should know about CAPLYTA?

  • Medicines like CAPLYTA can raise the risk of death in elderly people who have lost touch with reality (psychosis) due to confusion and memory loss (dementia). CAPLYTA is not approved for treating people with dementia-related psychosis.
  • CAPLYTA and antidepressant medicines increase the risk of suicidal thoughts and actions in people 24 years of age and younger, especially within the first few months of treatment or when the dose is changed. Depression and other serious mental illnesses are the most important causes of suicidal thoughts and actions.
    • Patients and their families or caregivers should watch for new or worsening depression symptoms, especially sudden changes in mood, behaviors, thoughts, or feelings. This is very important when CAPLYTA or an antidepressant medicine is started or when the dose is changed.
    • Report any changes in these symptoms to your healthcare provider immediately.

      • thoughts about suicide or dying
      • acting aggressive, being angry or violent
      • new or worse anxiety
      • suicide attempts

  • new or worse depression
  • an extreme increase in activity and talking (mania)
  • panic attacks
  • new or worse irritability

  • feeling very agitated or restless 
  • trouble sleeping
  • acting on dangerous impulses
  • other unusual changes in behavior or mood

Do not take CAPLYTA if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. Get emergency medical help if you are having an allergic reaction (e.g., rash, itching, hives, swelling of the tongue, lip, face, or throat).

What are the possible side effects of CAPLYTA?

CAPLYTA may cause serious side effects, including:

  • Stroke (cerebrovascular problems) in elderly people with dementia-related psychosis that can lead to death.
  • Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (NMS): high fever, confusion, changes in your breathing, heart rate, and blood pressure, stiff muscles, and increased sweating; these may be symptoms of a rare but potentially fatal condition. Contact your healthcare provider or go to the emergency room if you experience signs and symptoms of NMS.
  • Uncontrolled body movements (tardive dyskinesia, TD) in your face, tongue, or other body parts. TD may not go away, even if you stop taking CAPLYTA. It may also occur after you stop taking CAPLYTA.
  • Problems with your metabolism including high blood sugar, diabetes, increased fat (cholesterol and triglyceride) levels in your blood and weight gain. Your healthcare provider should check your blood sugar, fat levels, and weight before you start and during your treatment with CAPLYTA.
    • Extremely high blood sugar levels can lead to coma or death. Call your healthcare provider if you have any of the following symptoms of high blood sugar: feeling very thirsty, hungry, sick to your stomach, needing to urinate more than usual, weak/tired, or confused, or your breath smells fruity.
  • Low white blood cell count. Your healthcare provider may do blood tests during the first few months of treatment with CAPLYTA.
  • Decreased blood pressure (orthostatic hypotension). You may feel lightheaded, dizzy, or faint when you rise too quickly from a sitting or lying position.
  • Falls. CAPLYTA may make you sleepy or dizzy, may cause a decrease in your blood pressure when changing position (orthostatic hypotension), and can slow your thinking and motor skills which may lead to falls that can cause broken bones or other injuries.
  • Seizures (convulsions).
  • Sleepiness, drowsiness, feeling tired, difficulty thinking and doing normal activities. Until you know how CAPLYTA affects you, do not drive, operate heavy machinery, or do other dangerous activities.
  • Problems controlling your body temperature so that you feel too warm. Avoid getting overheated or dehydrated while taking CAPLYTA.
  • Difficulty swallowing that can cause food or liquid to get into the lungs.

The most common side effects of CAPLYTA include sleepiness, dizziness, nausea, dry mouth, feeling tired, and diarrhea.

These are not all the possible side effects of CAPLYTA.

Before taking CAPLYTA, tell your healthcare provider about all of your medical conditions, including if you: have or have had heart problems or a stroke, high or low blood pressure, diabetes, or high blood sugar, problems with cholesterol, have or have had a low white blood cell count, seizures (convulsions), or kidney or liver problems.

CAPLYTA may cause fertility problems in females and males. You should notify your healthcare provider if you become pregnant or intend to become pregnant while taking CAPLYTA. There is a pregnancy registry for females who are exposed to CAPLYTA during pregnancy. CAPLYTA may cause abnormal involuntary movements and/or withdrawal symptoms in newborn babies exposed to CAPLYTA during the third trimester. Talk to your healthcare provider if you breastfeed or are planning to breastfeed as CAPLYTA passes into breast milk.

Tell your healthcare provider about all the medicines you're taking. CAPLYTA may affect the way other medicines work, and other medicines may affect how CAPLYTA works, causing possible serious side effects. Do not start or stop any medicines while taking CAPLYTA without talking to your healthcare provider. You are encouraged to report negative side effects of prescription drugs. Contact Intra-Cellular Therapies, Inc. at 1-800-526-7736 or FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088 or www.fda.gov/medwatch.

DALLAS, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- enCore Energy Corp. (NASDAQ: EU; TSXV: EU) (the "Company" or "enCore") is pleased to announce that the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality ("TCEQ") has issued the Production Area Authorization ("PAA") for the first wellfield ("PAA-1") at the Company's 100% owned Upper Spring Creek In-Situ Recovery ("ISR") Uranium Project ("USC") in South Texas.

Highlights

  • Final authorization received: TCEQ issued PAA-1 for USC within the Company's previously disclosed timeline.
  • Plans to begin extraction:  The Company is making final inspections and expect oxygenated water injection and uranium extraction to begin the first week of December.
  • One remaining step to full-scale operations: The Company is working on getting final approval to operate the Waste Disposal Well (WDW-467) at USC, which will handle the saline water stream generated by wellfield operations. The WDW is fully constructed with approval expected in December.

"Receiving the final authorization for Upper Spring Creek is an important milestone for enCore," said Rich Little, Chief Executive Officer. "The plant and wellfield are built and ready, and our team is focused on completing the last regulatory step. Once the Waste Disposal Well is approved, we expect to bring the wellfield up to full-scale operations and begin delivering the growth in extraction that our South Texas investments were designed to provide."

Upper Spring Creek Permitting Update

PAA-1 authorizes uranium extraction within the first defined wellfield area at USC and is the final wellfield permit required for injection and recovery. The Satellite Ion Exchange ("IX") Plant and first wellfield were constructed ahead of the authorization.

ISR operations recover slightly more solution from a wellfield than is injected in order to keep wellfield solutions contained. This excess saline water, known as the bleed stream, is disposed of through a permitted deep disposal well. The WDW at USC has been constructed for this purpose, and TCEQ approval to operate it is the remaining step before the wellfield can be brought up to its designed operating rates. The Company expects to receive this approval in December and will update the market when the wellfield moves to full-scale operations.

USC is the largest satellite facility the Company has built to date. Uranium-loaded resin from the Satellite IX Plant will be trucked to the Rosita CPP, where it will be processed into yellowcake.

About the Upper Spring Creek ISR Project

The 100% Company-owned Project consists of a Satellite IX Plant and wellfield and is a key component of enCore's larger South Texas Uranium Project. This satellite facility will operate in conjunction with multiple future potential production units within the historic Clay West uranium district. The Project was previously held by Signal Equities LLC, which previously had licensed and permitted the property including the aquifer exemption as an ISR uranium project prior to 2020. The Company acquired the Project in December 2020. The uranium-mineralized sands at the Project lie within the Oakville Formation at depths typically between 300 and 450 feet below surface, allowing for efficient and economical uranium recovery with ISR methods.

Technical Disclosure and Qualified Person

Dain McCoig, P.E., MBA, enCore's Chief Operating Officer, and a Qualified Person under Canadian National Instrument 43-101 and S-K 1300, has reviewed and approved the technical disclosure in this news release on behalf of the Company.

enCore Energy Corp., America's Clean Energy Company™, is committed to providing clean, reliable, and affordable uranium to fuel the rapidly expanding U.S. nuclear energy needs. enCore's team is led by industry experts with extensive knowledge and experience in all aspects of uranium ISR operations and the nuclear fuel cycle. enCore exclusively uses ISR for uranium extraction, a minimally invasive, eco-friendly, and economically competitive mineral extraction technology co-developed by enCore's leadership.

Building on enCore's demonstrated and continuing success in South Texas, future projects in enCore's planned project pipeline include the expansion of Alta Mesa to include the Alta Mesa East property, the Dewey Burdock project in South Dakota, and the Gas Hills project in Wyoming.
